tools.description: List all user strategies with alignment scores. Returns strategy UUIDs, names, latest alignment score/label, and last evaluation timestamp.
tools.name: kova_list_strategies

tools.description: Read a strategy's full content and metadata including alignment score and performance metrics.
tools.name: kova_show_strategy

tools.description: Permanently delete a strategy and all associated data (emails, manual assets). Associated briefs are preserved but unlinked. This action cannot be undone.

strategy_uuid.description: UUID of the strategy to delete

tools.name: kova_delete_strategy

tools.description: Create a new investment strategy. Before calling this tool, help the user draft their strategy — it can be three lines or a detailed playbook. Good strategies include: target allocations with actual tickers (e.g. "40% VOO, 20% QQQ, 15% IBIT"), investment horizon and objective, action rules (e.g. "rebalance at 5% drift, sell calls when neutral"), and constraints (e.g. "no single position over 15%, no leverage"). Concrete tickers and rules produce specific dollar-based analysis; vague language produces generic commentary. After creating a strategy, use kova_create_asset and kova_create_liability to register non-ticker holdings and obligations before evaluating.
tools.name: kova_create_strategy

tools.description: Update an existing strategy's name, content, or both. Provide at least one of name or content.

strategy_uuid.description: UUID of the strategy to update

tools.name: kova_save_strategy

tools.description: Submit a portfolio for evaluation against a strategy. The portfolio param expects individual ticker holdings (stocks, options, cash) — for accounts where individual tickers aren't accessible (investment accounts, 401k, real estate), use kova_create_asset instead, then omit portfolio entirely to evaluate using only registered assets. Use kova_create_liability for persistent obligations like lines of credit or mortgages. Submitting a portfolio also updates the portfolio on file for this strategy. Returns a brief_id with status 'processing' — call kova_show_brief with that brief_id until status is 'completed' to get the full brief with alignment score, analysis, and compliance checks. Evaluation typically takes 60–90 seconds.

context.description: Additional context for evaluation (market signals, reasoning, constraints)

portfolio.description: Current holdings as free text, CSV, or JSON (e.g. 'AAPL 100 shares, MSFT 50 shares, $5,000 cash'). Kova normalizes the input automatically. Omit to reuse the strategy's existing portfolio data.

portfolio_kind.description: Provenance of a supplied portfolio. Default unknown. Only actual observations may support Strategy Intelligence patterns.

reported_at.description: Optional source timestamp. Omit if unknown; cannot be in the future.

tools.name: kova_evaluate_portfolio

tools.description: Read a brief by ID. Returns status ('processing' or 'completed') and, when completed, the alignment score, label, markdown analysis, summary, and timestamps. Use 'latest' as brief_id to get the most recent brief. When status is 'processing', the response includes elapsed_seconds, expected_duration_seconds (~90s), retry_after_seconds, and a human-readable message — briefs typically complete in 60–120 seconds, so wait retry_after_seconds before calling again.

brief_id.description: Brief ID, or "latest" to get the most recent brief

tools.name: kova_show_brief

tools.description: List all completed briefs for a strategy with ID, alignment score, and timestamps.
tools.name: kova_list_briefs

tools.description: List the version history for a strategy. Each entry captures the content before it was overwritten. Returns version numbers, names, previews, and timestamps. Use this before editing a strategy to understand what has changed over time.
tools.name: kova_list_strategy_versions

tools.description: Read the full content of a specific strategy version snapshot.
tools.name: kova_show_strategy_version

tools.description: Restore a strategy to a previous version. The current content is automatically saved as a new version before the restore, so nothing is permanently lost.
tools.name: kova_restore_strategy_version

tools.description: Run an ephemeral what-if simulation — evaluates a portfolio against a strategy without saving any records. Use this to check a specific trade idea ('should I sell puts on MARA at 15?'), test a hypothetical portfolio composition, or compare scenarios before committing. Results are temporary (expire after 1 hour) and never appear in brief history. For research-heavy scenarios, enrich with market data (earnings, price action, analyst sentiment) before calling this tool and pass it via context. Optionally override the strategy text to test 'what if my strategy said X?' without modifying the stored strategy. Returns a simulation_id with status 'processing' — call kova_show_simulation with that simulation_id until status is 'completed'. Simulation typically takes 60–120 seconds.

context.description: Additional context for this simulation: trade idea, market signals, earnings data, reasoning, constraints.

portfolio.description: Proposed holdings to simulate, as free text, CSV, or JSON (e.g. '60% VTI, 40% BND' or 'AAPL 100 shares, $5,000 cash'). Kova normalizes the input automatically.

strategy_content.description: Override the strategy text for this simulation only. Use to test 'what if my strategy said X?' without modifying the stored strategy.

tools.name: kova_simulate_portfolio

tools.description: Read a simulation result by ID. Returns status ('processing' or 'completed') and, when completed, the alignment score, analysis, and summary. Simulations expire after 1 hour. When status is 'processing', the response includes elapsed_seconds, expected_duration_seconds (~120s), retry_after_seconds, and a human-readable message — simulations typically complete in 80–160 seconds, so wait retry_after_seconds before calling again.
tools.name: kova_show_simulation

tools.description: Read the current portfolio on file for a strategy — the most recent holdings (stocks, options, cash, assets, and liabilities) with performance metrics. Persisted manual assets and liabilities include uuid values so agents can update or remove existing records without creating duplicates.
tools.name: kova_show_portfolio

tools.description: Register a non-ticker asset on a strategy — anything owned and tracked by total value rather than individual ticker symbols. Use this for managed accounts where tickers aren't accessible: robo-advisors, 401k plans, real estate, or other lump-sum holdings. Once registered, the asset is part of the strategy's portfolio and is included in every evaluation. Types: investment_account, real_estate, bitcoin, other. Bitcoin uses live pricing — omit current_value and provide quantity instead. After registering assets, call kova_evaluate_portfolio without a portfolio param to generate a brief.

current_value.description: Total current value in USD. Required for all types except bitcoin (which uses live pricing — omit current_value and provide quantity instead).

notes.description: Optional notes about the asset (e.g. 'US stocks + bonds, auto-rebalanced')

quantity.description: Units held. Required for bitcoin (e.g. 0.5 BTC); defaults to 1 for all other types.

tools.name: kova_create_asset

tools.description: Update a non-ticker asset on a strategy. Merge semantics — only supplied fields change. Provide at least one field to update.

asset_uuid.description: Asset UUID to update (returned by kova_create_asset or by kova_show_portfolio for existing manual assets)

current_value.description: New total current value in USD

tools.name: kova_update_asset

tools.description: Remove a non-ticker asset from a strategy. The asset UUID is returned by kova_create_asset or by kova_show_portfolio for existing manual assets.
tools.name: kova_remove_asset

tools.description: Register a non-portfolio liability on a strategy. Use this for persistent obligations like a line of credit, mortgage, personal loan, or other debt that should be visible during evaluation. Liabilities are included as structured context in every evaluation but do not change portfolio value math in this iteration.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code. Defaults to USD.

name.description: Liability name. E.g. 'Wealthfront Portfolio LOC', 'Primary Mortgage'

notes.description: Optional notes about the liability (e.g. 'secured by taxable portfolio')

tools.name: kova_create_liability

tools.description: Update a liability on a strategy. Merge semantics — only supplied fields change. Provide at least one field to update.

liability_uuid.description: Liability UUID to update (returned by kova_create_liability or by kova_show_portfolio for existing liabilities)

tools.name: kova_update_liability

tools.description: Remove a liability from a strategy. The liability UUID is returned by kova_create_liability or by kova_show_portfolio for existing liabilities.
tools.name: kova_remove_liability

tools.description: Record a deposit or withdrawal on a strategy's portfolio. Cash flows adjust performance calculations — deposits don't count as gains, withdrawals don't count as losses. Use this to track contributions, distributions, or transfers that affect the portfolio's value but aren't investment returns.

amount.description: Positive dollar amount of the cash flow

flow_type.description: Type of cash flow: 'deposit' (money added) or 'withdrawal' (money removed)

occurred_on.description: Date the cash flow occurred (ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-05-01'). Defaults to today.

tools.name: kova_record_cash_flow

tools.description: List all recorded cash flows (deposits and withdrawals) for a strategy's portfolio. Returns flows ordered by date, most recent first.
tools.name: kova_list_cash_flows

tools.description: Remove a cash flow record from a strategy's portfolio. Use kova_list_cash_flows to find the cash_flow_id.

cash_flow_id.description: Cash flow ID to remove (returned by kova_record_cash_flow or kova_list_cash_flows)

tools.name: kova_remove_cash_flow

tools.description: Read strategy understanding, processing state, and the primary question. Read-only; never starts work.
tools.name: kova_show_strategy_intelligence

tools.description: Request or retry an asynchronous Strategy Intelligence check. Does not change strategy text or briefs. Equivalent in-progress or completed requests reuse existing work.
tools.name: kova_assess_strategy

tools.description: Read strategy questions and history, newest first, 25 per page. Pass next_cursor as before.
tools.name: kova_list_strategy_advisories

tools.description: Read a question, its dated evidence, and up to 50 saved responses. Pass next_response_cursor as response_cursor for older responses.
tools.name: kova_show_strategy_advisory

tools.description: Save a user-provided explanation or question action. Relay the user's words; never invent motives or answers. Read the revision first. Supply a unique request_id and reuse it only for an exact retry. Replies and corrections require text and queue interpretation. Strategy content and briefs are unchanged.
tools.name: kova_respond_to_strategy_advisory
